run: 2026-11-12, local: yosys 0.33, z3 4.8.12, SymbiYosys (formal-deb env); review-fix reruns of interlocks (with req_noref) and order_ctl on the final RTL

assumptions.interlocks: configuration stable after reset; bucket <= 4; refill 3..6 clocks; reload not used; every other input free (including the no-band-reference request flag)
assumptions.mac_tx: MIN_DATA 4, IFG 3, frame length 1..6 bytes, a byte every clock (1000 Mb/s)
assumptions.mac_rx: MIN_FRAME 5, MAX_FRAME 8; the CRC abstracted as a free value (checked against zlib in simulation)
assumptions.order_ctl: every input free; an abstract MAC (3-clock frames); watchdog 8 clocks; one ghost order tracked from its request (anyconst choice); bounded check, not a proof: a bad-frame order is never started once known, a good-FCS one is followed by a cancel within 12 clocks, a cancel only follows a bad frame or the watchdog, safe mode never sends before a good verdict, the slot is never busy for more than 24 clocks

not_proved: k-induction of the MAC FSMs (needs invariants on internal state); returned UNKNOWN, so those tasks were removed
